purpose: Preserve the frozen realized-funding falsification audit trail and prevent workers from tuning or rescuing a fingerprint that failed its predeclared incremental-profitability requirements.

immutable_feature.name: realized_funding_pressure_24h_bps
immutable_feature.definition: 10000 * sum(realizedRate) for realized funding observations with fundingTime in (forecast_ts - 24h, forecast_ts]

hypothesis.primary_question: Does pre-forecast realized funding pressure add stable incremental after-cost information for 24h or 7d crypto direction/return beyond unconditional market direction and existing evidence?
hypothesis.direction_rule: Learn only the sign of the feature/forward-return association from the chronological training segment and freeze it before OOS scoring; no OOS threshold search.
hypothesis.economic_intuition_is_not_evidence: Crowded funding may precede continuation or mean reversion; the data must determine the training-only association sign.

24h.reason: Absolute returns remained positive after fixed costs, but the funding signal added exactly zero incremental OOS expectancy versus the training-only constant-direction baseline, directional hit rate was 50%, and the OOS halves were unstable with the second half negative. The predeclared incremental-profitability and stability requirements therefore fail. Do not tune or rescue the 24h fingerprint.

7d.reason: Only six non-overlapping chronological OOS observations were available, below the predeclared minimum of eight, so the 7d horizon fails closed before scoring. Do not infer profitability from an underpowered sample or open untouched OOS.

rejection_rules: reject if timestamp/provenance safety cannot be defended
reject if realized funding coverage is insufficient or unstable
reject if fewer than 8 independent OOS samples remain for a primary horizon
reject if canonical after-cost OOS expectancy is non-positive
reject if incremental OOS expectancy versus the training-only constant-direction baseline is non-positive or unstable
reject if the apparent edge disappears under fixed 2x/3x cost stress
reject if OOS subperiods or training checkpoints show material sign instability
reject if the feature is redundant with existing evidence or fails multiple-testing/robustness controls
forbidden_actions: do not retry unchanged Binance historical-OI route
do not retry unchanged Bybit historical-OI route
do not assume an 8-hour funding interval
do not tune thresholds from OOS outcomes
do not attach historical funding retrospectively to old prediction-ledger rows
do not open untouched OOS from this candidate-selection step
do not tune, rescue, or resurrect DATA-FUNDING-001 without a materially different predeclared fingerprint and new rationale
do not create paper, broker, promotion, or live-trading authority
next_step: Retire DATA-FUNDING-001 from active profitability research and select a genuinely new timestamp-defensible candidate with expected incremental after-cost value. Preserve this negative result so autonomous workers do not repeat it.
